Chapter 703 - 703 Constantly Cursing; Demonic Sense

Chapter 703 - 703 Constantly Cursing; Demonic Sense

703 Constantly Cursing; Demonic Sense

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

Lin Fan had just spent 10,000 spirit stones to curse Xing Baokun for the day.

At this moment, a crisp notification suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Your enemy, Xing Baokun, has demonic thoughts because of your curse.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he smiled and said, “It’s finally working. I didn’t curse him for an entire year in vain. However, he only has demonic thoughts. I still have to work harder!”

…

On a distant planet, on the Flying Peak of the Sky Thunder Sect…

Xing Baokun, who had been in a state of cultivation, suddenly burst out with a cold and fierce force. Like a ferocious beast, he directly tore the servant beside him into pieces.

Bright red blood splattered everywhere.

Xing Baokun opened his eyes, and they were bloodshot.

After taking a few deep breaths, he calmed down and said, “What exactly happened? Why did I suddenly become so irritable?

“Is there a problem with the cultivation technique?”

He thought for a moment and began to change his cultivation technique.

However, not long after, a sharp force burst out of his body and pierced a huge hole in the roof.

The commotion here attracted the attention of many people on the Flying Peak.

They hurried in.

“Master, what happened?”

“Master, what’s wrong?”

…

Everyone asked.

Xing Baokun completely ignored the crowd as he leaped out of the hole and directly arrived in front of the Sky Thunder Sect’s master, Lu Qinghong.

He told him about his situation.

When Lu Qinghong heard this, he stretched out his hand to sense Xing Baokun’s physical condition.

Soon, he frowned.

“Your aura is so restless…”

He thought for a moment and said, “Let’s go and consult the Grand Elder.”

Thus, the two of them turned into streams of light and arrived at a tall tower.

“Greetings, Grand Elder.”

The white-haired Grand Elder, who had been resting with his eyes closed, did not even lift his eyelids. He said, “What is it?”

Xing Baokun explained his situation again.

When the Grand Elder heard this, he first sensed it.

Then, his hands continued to pinch.

“Have you made any enemies with anyone recently?”

Xing Baokun thought for a moment and said, “Not in a hundred years.”

He had killed many servants and ordinary people in the past hundred years.

However, in Xing Baokun’s opinion, this was not a grudge.

This was because servants and ordinary people were not considered humans at all.

The Grand Elder said, “You’ve been cursed. Moreover, it’s a relatively powerful curse. If you want to solve it, you have to find the person who cursed you. Before that, you have to use your own energy to resist the curse.”

After Xing Baokun returned to the Flying Peak, he sorted out all his enemies in his mind.

He realized that his enemies were either dead or did not know how to curse.

Who was cursing him?

Strange!

Xing Baokun was confused.

…

In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.

“Master, the last time Senior Brother Xing Yu was seen was at 14567-23412, southeast of the Spring Region. Also, according to our intelligence, someone saw a terrifying battle nearby.”

A loud voice sounded outside the mountain.

Xing Baokun’s eyes shot out a scarlet light, and he let out a deep, beast-like voice.

“Xing Yu! It must be the person who killed Xing Yu! He’s the one cursing me!”

Xing Baokun had already entered a state of madness.

Anyone who had a grudge against him, he felt that the other party was cursing him.

Because of this, he had caused millions of killings in the past three years.

This time, he did not know that he had accidentally guessed it right and found the root of the problem.

…

On the other hand, on Earth.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-Six Domain Lord (8.9 billion/1 trillion)]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Ordinary), Curse Spell (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Cosmos Sword Technique (Emperor)…]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Ordinary), Flame Armor (Emperor), Heavenly Soul Bead (Emperor), True Dragon Sword (Emperor)…]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (intermediate), Metal (intermediate), Wood (intermediate), Water (intermediate), Fire (intermediate), Earth (intermediate), Life (intermediate), Death (elementary), Yin (elementary), Yang (elementary), Wind (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:]

[Lin Tao: Daddy; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability:Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

Lin Fan looked at his status panel and sighed. “In three years, my cultivation has only increased by three small realms. It’s too slow.”

Slow?

If others knew about this, who knew what kind of expression they would have.

One had to know…

Lin Fan’s increase of three small realms was not the small realm of Kill Hundred or Fight 1,000.

It was the Domain Lord level!

Which Domain Lord-level warrior would not need thousands of years to break through a small realm?

Lin Fan had only used three years and he thought that it was too slow?

[Ding! Congratulations, it’s been 34 years since you’ve owned the advanced system. You’ve received one Immortal Crystal, one Basic Rule Upgrade Gem, and one Transcendence Golden Body.]

Lin Fan looked at the Immortal Crystal that was filled with dense Spirit energy and the Transcendence Golden Body that looked just like him. The corners of his mouth curled up as he said, “With another Immortal Crystal, my cultivation speed should be able to increase a little more.”

In the past three years, Lin Fan had already obtained two Immortal Crystals, causing the spiritual energy in the Coiling Dragon Villa to reach an unimaginable level.

This was also one of the reasons why he had successfully broken through three minor realms in a short three years.

Then, Lin Fan placed his attention on the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem.

[Do you want to use the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem on Death Laws?]

“Yes!”

Instantly, Lin Fan’s body was surrounded by a black aura.

After a while, the black gas dissipated.

Lin Fan had a deeper understanding of Death Laws now.

He walked out of the room in a good mood.

“Lin Fan, the spiritual energy seems to have increased again?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

When the women heard this, they became even happier.

With the increase in spiritual energy, their cultivation speed would also increase.

Now, Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s cultivation had already reached the first level of the Planet realm.

The rest of them had all reached the Incarnation Realm!

Their strength could already compete with many planets directly. They could be said to be powerful.

Lin Fan said, “Today, I’ll talk about Death Laws.”

Death was extremely cold and terrifying.

At the same time, it was also a very powerful power of laws.

Lin Fan explained from the beginning to the end. The women listened very seriously.

A week later, all the women had their own understanding of Death Laws.

Just as Lin Fan was about to go deeper, a crisp notification sounded out in his mind.

[Ding! Level-Two Universe cultivator detected.]
